title: nan
authors: Araújo A.G.; Pizzino C.A.P.; Couceiro M.S.; Rocha R.P.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-drone system proof of concept using LiDAR/visual SLAM for autonomous forestry inventory and mapping in GNSS-denied canopies.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
